What is the role of the Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages for Canada? The Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages for Canada is responsible for ensuring that the rights of Canadians are protected under the Official Languages Act. The Commissioner of Official Languages for Canada is an Officer of Parliament, appointed by Parliament to oversee the implementation of the Official Languages Act. The Commissioner of Official Languages for Canada investigates complaints from the public regarding the use of official languages in the federal government. The Commissioner of Official Languages for Canada also promotes the use of official languages in the federal government and in Canadian society. The Commissioner of Official Languages for Canada reports to Parliament on the implementation of the Official Languages Act and on the use of official languages in the federal government.
